panel.w_h1: From field to export — one managed chain
panel.w_hlede: Agro Zanjir brings the journey of agricultural produce, from harvest to final payment, into a single digital system: quality, storage, finance, insurance, logistics and export, all under one lot identifier.
panel.w_prob_t: Value is lost after the harvest
panel.w_prob_p: The problem is not mainly how much is grown. Production, storage, finance, insurance, logistics and export are disconnected from one another. Without longer shelf life, finance gets expensive; without insurance, a bank will not take the risk; without traceability, the premium market stays closed.
panel.w_sol_t: Not separate facilities — one operating architecture
panel.w_sol_p: Every consignment gets a single identifier, and everything that happens to it is written to an immutable log. That one record shows the same truth to the farmer, the hub, the bank, the insurer, the carrier and the buyer.
panel.w_st1d: From the field to final settlement
panel.w_st2d: From a farm to a ministry

panel.w_ab_lede: Agro Zanjir is a value-chain concept developed on the initiative of the Assembly of the Economy of Uzbekistan.
panel.w_ab_mis_t: Turn “value created” into “value sold and paid for”
panel.w_ab_mis_p1: Reducing losses, quality degradation, forced cheap sales, the financing gap and the transaction cost of exporting — that is the project’s central task.
panel.w_ab_mis_p2: We are not offering farmers “one more service”. We are building the operating architecture that closes the gaps between the services that already exist.
panel.w_ab_pr1d: Demand, specification and the sales window are settled before the planting decision.
panel.w_ab_pr2d: Technology and business model are tested on real produce before major capital expenditure.
panel.w_ab_pr3d: Not a replacement for every store; integrated where the added value is highest.
panel.w_ab_pr4d: Credit is strengthened by contract, inventory and quality data, not personal collateral alone.
panel.w_ab_pr5d: The risks of farmer, operator, bank, insurer and buyer are clearly separated.
panel.w_ab_pr6d: Every consignment is tracked with its origin, QC, storage, finance and logistics history.
panel.w_ab_gov_p: This is not one company’s product — it is governed through committees of the participating organisations.

panel.w_tc_ch_t: What the pilot has to confirm
panel.w_tc_ch_p: The curves below show the expected difference, not a measurement. The pilot replaces them with real readings.
panel.w_tc_ch_cap: Dashed means projected. Not one point here has been measured. After the Samarqand pilot these charts are redrawn on real data.
panel.w_n1a: The consignment was weighed at the gate, took its lot identifier and was split in two: half into the ZEROCO zone, half into a conventional cold zone. Both halves are measured on the same days — 0, 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, 49 and 56 — by the same method: weight loss, waste percentage and firmness.
panel.w_n1b: The condition that matters is that the comparison runs on produce from a single source. Comparing two consignments from different plots or different harvest dates makes the result unusable. The figures at the end of the observation are what the scale-up decision rests on.
panel.w_n2a: The working group exists to agree the procedure by which verified warehouse inventory becomes collateral a bank will accept. The bank needs three things for that: that the goods exist, what condition they are in, and that they cannot leave once pledged.
panel.w_n2b: In the platform all three come from one mechanism: the placement event, the continuous condition record and the encumbrance overlay. A pledged lot does not go out on dispatch — the system blocks that one transition.
panel.w_n3a: Buyer demand for grape and pomegranate is rising, but the newer destinations are stricter on documents and quality. A phytosanitary certificate, proof of origin and cold-chain history increasingly form part of the contract itself.
panel.w_n3b: Those requirements remain the strongest commercial argument for digitising the chain: instead of being assembled by hand, the paperwork arrives with the consignment already complete.
panel.w_n4a: Every consignment takes its lot identifier the moment the weight is recorded. Each event after that — the QC result, placement into a zone, a temperature excursion, a pledge, dispatch and customs — attaches to that identifier and is written to a log that cannot be deleted from.
panel.w_n4b: A buyer scanning the QR code sees the public part of that log: where the produce came from, how it was stored and how it was checked. A record cannot be altered — only a new event can be added.
panel.w_bn_p: Each module works on its own, but all of them work on one lot identifier — which is why running them together does not duplicate a single record.
panel.w_bn_lotd: A consignment takes its identifier the moment it leaves the scale. QC, zone, temperature, pledge, dispatch and customs all write to it, and nothing can be deleted.
panel.w_bn_find: The bank sees the warehouse state itself; a pledged lot does not go out on dispatch.
panel.w_bn_condd: Temperature and humidity are logged automatically; an excursion becomes an evidence bundle.
panel.w_ab_note: This site describes a concept. It is not an investment offer, a banking product or terms of insurance. ZEROCO technical parameters require verification through the pilot.

panel.w_sr_note: Volumes shown are indicative. Exact availability, calibre and delivery window are confirmed on enquiry.
panel.w_tc_lede: At the physical centre of the chain sits a storage layer that extends product quality and the sales window.
panel.w_tc_how_p: ZEROCO’s materials describe a technology based on holding food in a controlled environment of approximately 0 °C and near-100% humidity, preserving the product’s moisture state and slowing quality degradation. The company recommends treating it not as a replacement for ordinary refrigeration, but as a layer that adds value inside an existing cold chain.
panel.w_tc_pilot_p: Results obtained in other countries are not a guarantee in Uzbek conditions. The concept therefore gates scale-up behind a verified pilot: one source consignment is divided in two and measured on the same schedule.
panel.w_tc_gate_p: ZEROCO is scaled not because it “stores for longer”, but where the value of additional sales and reduced losses exceeds its capital and operating cost, for that product and that region.
panel.w_tc_disc: The technical description on this page is based on materials from ZEROCO inc. and Nippon Engineering Co., Ltd. and is preliminary.
panel.w_pt_lede: The chain is not built by one organisation, but together with state bodies, financial institutions, technology and operating partners.
